neighbours.label: the token inside a relative clause just before 'based', 'depends' or 'hinges': 'on which the conclusion is', 'upon which future plans could'
fire: These are the assumptions on which the whole forecast is based.
It was a test case upon which later reforms could be modelled.
Trust is the foundation upon which every marriage is built.
The data on which their theory depends were never published.
He questioned the facts upon which the verdict was based.
That single vote is the point on which the election may hinge.
The principle on which the company was founded still matters.
This treaty is the framework upon which peace must rest.
quiet: These are the assumptions that the whole team wrote down.
It was a test case in the county court last spring.
Trust is the word that every speaker used at the wedding.
The data from their survey were never published.
He questioned the witnesses in the verdict's final week.
That single vote was counted twice during the election.
The bench on which the company's founder sat still stands.
This treaty is the one that the ministers signed in Paris.
